Trace, implement and test: leetcode309 best time to buy and sell stock with cooldown dp

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxProfit(vector<int>& prices) {
        int hold = INT_MIN, sold = 0, cooled = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < prices.size(); i++)
        {
            int preHold = hold;
            int preSold = sold;
            int preCooled = cooled;

            int p = prices[i];
            hold = max(preHold, preCooled - p);
            sold = preHold + p; /* 如果hold的初始值设置为0就会有问题了, 可以将hold的初始值设置为 INT_MIN */
            cooled = max(preCooled, preSold);
        }
        return max(sold, cooled);
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> prices = {1,2,3,0,2};
    auto res = sol.maxProfit(prices);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
